title: Promotions
intro: Let nearby people know about your event or your stand at a market. Every promotion is labelled "Sponsored".
label: Sponsored
monthly_one: +{{count}} credit every month with your plan
monthly_other: +{{count}} credits every month with your plan
activated: Promotion active: notifications are going out.
paidByCard: Payment received: the promotion starts within a few minutes.
cancelConfirm: Cancel the promotion? If you paid with credits they go back to your balance.

empty.title: No promotions yet
empty.description: Promote one of your upcoming events or a live "I'm here" post.

rules: Each person gets at most 2 sponsored notifications a week and never the same one twice. Minors don't get them and anyone can turn them off. No external links, contacts or off-app payments.

FeaturedEvent.name: Featured event
FeaturedEvent.hint: At the top of nearby events, plus a notification to people in range.

SponsoredBroadcast.name: Sponsored "I'm here"
SponsoredBroadcast.hint: Also reaches people who don't follow you, if they want one of your cards.

StoreSlot.name: Store slot
StoreSlot.hint: A card on the Home and in the store list, for 7 days.

ShowcaseSlot.name: Stall slot
ShowcaseSlot.hint: A card on the Home and in Explore that leads to your showcase, for 7 days.

none.SponsoredBroadcast: You have no live "I'm here" post.

duration.FeaturedEvent: Stays featured until the event starts (14 days at most).
duration.SponsoredBroadcast: Lasts as long as your "I'm here" post.
duration.StoreSlot: Visible for 7 days, at most 3 times a day per person.
duration.ShowcaseSlot: Visible for 7 days, at most 3 times a day per person.

how.FeaturedEvent: The notification goes to adults in range who haven't turned it off (and who play that game, if the event has one).
how.SponsoredBroadcast: The notification goes to adults in range who don't follow you yet and want a card you have available.
how.StoreSlot: The card appears among the Home cards and the stores, only to adults in range. No notifications.
how.ShowcaseSlot: The card appears among the Home and Explore cards, only to adults in range. No notifications.
